text:
Ava Patel: Quick heads up — CloudConnect marketplace listing goes live next Thu (5/12). We need a tight launch plan: blog post, benchmark blurb, joint webinar, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what?
Ravi Kumar: I can own partner comms + liaison with CloudConnect PMs. Will sync on co-branded assets.
Jordan Lee: I’ll take the blog + benchmark narrative. Need raw numbers from eng — can someone drop the 95th/median latency and cost/unit for the 8k token test?
Sofia Mendes: I’ll run webinar ops — date options? also will map registration -> SDR handoff flow.
Ava Patel: Thanks. Timeline: draft blog by Tue, assets and landing copy by Wed, webinar registration up by Fri. Can we confirm eng numbers today?
Ravi Kumar: PM just sent a short perf summary in the partner doc: https://tiny.redwood/cc-perf (see table at bottom). I’ll paste a screenshot to the doc.
Jordan Lee: Copy that. If eng numbers are confirmed I’ll write a benchmark section focused on 'cost per request' and 'latency consistency'. Want a single chart comparing hosted vs dedicated for typical web request.
Sofia Mendes: Proposed webinar slot: Wed 5/18 9am PT or Thu 5/19 11am PT. Prefer Wed. Panel: Ravi + Ava + CloudConnect PM + Solutions engineer. 30 min + 15 Q&A.
Ava Patel: Wed 5/18 9am PT works for the team. Jordan — can you draft a 1-slide benchmark summary for the webinar deck? Keep it high-level.
Jordan Lee: Yep. Will include one chart + 3 bullets: methodology, top-line results, what customers should expect.
Sofia Mendes: Routing note — please tag leads from webinar and marketplace as: "source:cloudconnect_marketplace" and "origin:webinar_5_18" so SDR flow can split. Example inbound rule I’ll add to Gainsight/SFDC:
```
if lead.source contains "cloudconnect_marketplace" then owner = PartnershipsQueue
if lead.origin == "webinar_5_18" then owner = WebinarNurtureQueue, priority = High
```
Ravi Kumar: Good call on tags. I’ll make sure CloudConnect registration payload includes UTM + partner_ref.
Ava Patel: CTA copy options for listing: 1) "Try Redwood on CloudConnect" 2) "See Redwood inference benchmarks" 3) "Schedule a private demo" — which do we prioritize?
Jordan Lee: For the listing, prioritize the benchmark CTA (#2) and have demo as secondary. Listing traffic skews evaluation-first.
Sofia Mendes: For webinar registration, primary CTA = demo opt-in checkbox. Allows SDRs to split hot leads faster.
Ava Patel: Ok owners: Ravi = partner comms + marketplace asset handoff; Jordan = blog + benchmark slide; Sofia = webinar ops + routing rules; Ava = launch copy + final approvals.
deploy-bot: Reminder: assets folder created at /marketing/cloudconnect/launch (permissions: marketing + partnerships).
Ravi Kumar: I’ll upload logos and co-branding guidelines there by EOD.
Jordan Lee: Draft blog ETA Tue EOD, will ping for numbers if anything changes.
Sofia Mendes: Webinar landing draft will be up Thu AM. I’ll also drop the SFDC routing doc in the same folder.
Ava Patel: Perfect. Follow-ups: Ravi please confirm we have approval to use CloudConnect logo in the blog (need written ok). Once we have that, I’ll post the launch on Tuesday morning. :rocket:
Ravi Kumar: Got it — asking legal/partner PM for formal approval now.
Ava Patel: Thanks all. Small checklist saved to the folder. Ping here if blockers.
Sofia Mendes: Noted. I’ll schedule a 15-min dry run with panel on Mon 5/16.
Jordan Lee: Adding a quick QA: can we capture one customer quote or use-case snippet for the blog? Ravi, can you ask CloudConnect for a short blurb?
Ravi Kumar: On it. I’ll request a 1-2 sentence quote focused on latency and cost savings.
Ava Patel: Last call — anything else?
Sofia Mendes: One more: can design prepare a 1200x628 hero image variant and a square social card? Requesting by Wed morning.
Ava Patel: Adding that to the folder and tagging design. Closing thread once assets are in.
Ravi Kumar: Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: File permission change: marketing + partnerships can edit /marketing/cloudconnect/launch (timestamp 1845123567).
